1. Main Components to Include:

- Desktop UI (Compose for Desktop)
- Theme System
- Localization System
- Custom Window Management

b. Core Application Layer:
- Download Manager Core
- Queue Management System
- Category Management
- Settings Management
- Update System

c. Integration Layer:
- Browser Integration Server
- Native Messaging System
- Single Instance Management

d. Storage Layer:
- Download Database
- Configuration Storage
- Category Storage
- Queue Storage

2. Key Architectural Patterns to Highlight:

a. Multi-platform Architecture:
- Show separation between platform-specific code (Windows/Linux)
- Shared components and utilities
- Platform-specific implementations (especially for auto-start and tray features)

b. Component Communication:
- Event flow between UI and core download manager
- Integration communication patterns
- State management flow
